name: DIS3 like 3'-5' exoribonuclease 2

function.text: DIS3L2 encodes DIS3-like exonuclease 2. Annotated molecular activities include 3'-5'-RNA exonuclease activity and RNA nuclease activity. It participates in mRNA catabolic process and miRNA catabolic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Perlman syndrome (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
